basic_details.job_title: IIT Ropar Scientific Administrative Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online

qualification.details: (a) Experience with project management and accounts. | (b) Good knowledge of English for email communication and reporting.

selection_process: are not explicitly detailed in the notification beyond attending the interview at personal expense.
how_to_apply: Prepare a single PDF file containing all required documents in the defined order.
Include a detailed updated CV with a photo, category, marital status, contact number, and email address as the first document.
Include previous work experience if any.
Include a government-issued photo identity proof and age proof (original and photocopy).
Include certificates in descending order starting from the last degree up to class 10th along with original and photocopies of mark sheets/certificates.
Format the email subject as: Application - First Name Last name_Position applied for.
Send the email application directly to [email protected] by 21/10/2026.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. All terms and conditions of this recruitment will follow the guidelines of DST-SERB and IIT Ropar, Rupnagar, Punjab. Candidates must produce original certificates and mark sheets in support of educational qualifications and age at the time of joining for verification. The appointment is initially for three months with the possibility of extension based on performance on a yearly basis, co-terminus with the four-year project. The application must be sent as a single PDF file containing documents in the defined order.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for 1 Scientific Administrative Assistant position under the ANRF funded PAIR Project – DREAMS consortium at IIT Ropar.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Scientific Administrative Assistant post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to send email applications is 21/10/2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a graduate degree in any discipline and possess hands-on knowledge of computers and accounts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit and age restrictions are not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How should I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates must send email applications directly to [email protected] with a single PDF containing all required documents, following the specific email subject format.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fellowship/salary of Rs. 24,000 + 10% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the project appointment?
faq.answer: The project duration is four years, and the initial appointment is for three months with the possibility of extension based on performance on a yearly basis, co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q10. Where should applications be emailed?
faq.answer: Applications should be emailed to [email protected].
